wintercity_e11_entry.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_entry.text: On Day 885, Yue unfolded the extra orientation notes before going to breakfast. wintercity_e11_measured_001.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_measured_001.text: Her remaining employment, if any, had its own morning duties. She followed the actual current receipt and kept private sources out of the participant cover. wintercity_e11_measured_002.speaker: narrator

wintercity_e11_measured_004.text: After that particular account was handled, she kept the signed record with her ordinary money papers. The competitive form stayed separate. wintercity_e11_measured_006.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_measured_006.text: Gao Shen stood opposite her in the charcoal-indigo robe, its sleeves secured away from the participant arm. His bare hand settled on the other grip with no flourish. wintercity_e11_measured_008.text: At the start signal, she guided the permitted trace through the established small circuit into the prepared counter-movement. wintercity_e11_rested_009.speaker: narrator

She answered that the owner had supplied the greater valid counterforce. She could still be unhappy about it. The person looked disappointed to lose the hopeful account and went away. Yue found herself less alone after refusing it, because an imagined win would have left the bruised arm without any honest place in the story she told herself.

wintercity_e11_common_003.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_003.text: On Day 889, she went to Zhou An's ordinary clinic by the light route described on the care note. The visit cost eight copper from her earned personal funds; it was not silently included in yesterday's event payment. The clinician checked the skin, movement, swelling, and sensation. No fracture was found on the actual ordinary assessment. The bruising and strain still needed restricted use. He scheduled another review for Day 898, also eight copper unless a separately agreed fund actually covered it.

wintercity_e11_common_004.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_004.text: She paid the first review and reserved the next eight from her own money. The ordinary note allowed light tasks that did not load the injured arm, with rest intervals and no powered work through it yet. There was no pill that made the next morning a complete recovery. She asked about a hot meal and a wash, and received practical advice on temperature and keeping the support dry. The examination ended in a limitation she could actually follow rather than a new cultivation permission.

wintercity_e11_common_005.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_005.text: Mrs Fen found Yue trying to fasten the ordinary support with both hands and asked whether assistance would help. Yue said yes for that fastening, then no for carrying the light letter she could handle. The innkeeper accepted both answers without turning care into authority over the whole day. Yue bought a simple meal for one copper. She put the clinic paper where it could be found next week, leaving the public score in a different cover.

wintercity_e11_common_006.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_006.text: On Day 890, Wen returned an umbrella to a customer at the inn door. She asked how she had slept, not whether the loss had taught a greater secret. Yue admitted that the arm hurt when she turned too quickly. Wen said one of her repaired umbrella ribs had taken longer than the buyer expected, and did not try to make the comparison exact. They watched the customer open the umbrella beyond the doorway. The small ordinary success belonged to Wen and the customer's repaired cloth.

wintercity_e11_common_007.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_007.text: Yue took a short walk without the heavy folder. The ice had retreated from the central stones while remaining beneath the shaded wall. She passed the station from outside its closed fence and did not seek a rematch. Gao Shen's greater capacity remained a real part of the city. So did her own stage-seven circuit, now restricted in practical use by injury. Neither could be altered by replaying a brave release in her head until it became a different ending.

wintercity_e11_common_008.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_008.text: That evening she wrote a brief private account to her mother, using only a little ordinary ink at a time and stopping when the forearm tightened. She said she had lost a supervised comparison and received normal care. She did not ask her mother to leave home to look after her, or imply that a new rank had appeared. The one-copper dispatch went with the regular carrier. Her mother's existing helper and shoulder limits remained her mother's own actual arrangements.

wintercity_e11_common_009.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_009.text: Day 891 brought a public notice about the cold-term service schedule. The outcome of the comparison did not revoke every tenant's eligibility. The accepted room bookings and existing service map remained subject to their own conditions. Yue could read the notice without claiming a new public mandate. She marked a question about whether injury-related restricted workers could still use the open waiting space, then left the relevant request with the named office rather than privately ordering its keeper.

wintercity_e11_common_010.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_010.text: She spent the remaining afternoon listening to Aunt Peng's puppets rehearse through the courtyard door. The wood clacked together, stopped, and began again when the younger operator found the wrong string. Yue did not offer her injured arm to steady the frame. Peng already had a paid competent helper. Yue laughed at a line whose timing survived the mistake and felt the ordinary day move on around her, with no need to pretend the contest had become a victory.

wintercity_e11_common_011.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_011.text: Bai Jia sent word that the bean stall would reopen after its stove inspection on Day 892. Yue had no right to reopen it herself. She walked past the closed shutter and saw the paid technician checking the flue from a proper ladder, with another worker keeping the foot steady. The ordinary apparatus task was not a stage-seven challenge waiting for her help. Jia wanted company at the reopening, if the clinic restriction allowed the walk. Yue could promise only that limited visit.

wintercity_e11_common_012.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_012.text: A child in the inn court asked why the support was wrapped around Yue's arm. She said she had hurt it and was letting it mend under ordinary care. The child asked whether stronger qi would make the cloth unnecessary. Yue said stored energy did not mend this bruise for her. Mrs Fen offered the child a different task, carrying the empty breakfast bowls with both hands. The question remained answered without turning the courtyard into a lecture or demanding that Yue demonstrate a power.

wintercity_e11_common_013.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_013.text: Yue sorted the next week's food money with the uninjured hand and kept the eight-copper clinic reservation separate. Her journey reserve was still owned money, not a payment promised by an employer after a hearing. The amount needed to remain after present costs had been paid. She could take suitable ordinary work when offered, but could not spend an imagined future stipend now. The distinction felt harder than the written arithmetic when the forearm ache made a quiet day seem unusually long.

wintercity_e11_common_014.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e11_common_014.text: Before evening, the clinic desk confirmed Day 898 in its actual appointment book. Yue could reach it by the same light street route if the weather remained ordinary; a closed road would require a changed booking. She put the date beside her inn key. The next chapter of recovery would begin with tomorrow's restricted arm and existing care plan, rather than an unearned clearance arriving overnight. She asked Mrs Fen where the covered waiting bench stood if rain arrived before the visit.
